title: C4OS Grill Question 022 - Mutating Tool Defaults

questions.label: What should trusted-project file writes default to?
questions.help: Recommended: allow trusted-project writes when the user's request implies file work, but ask for destructive deletes or broad rewrites. This matches your Q021 direction while keeping high-impact mutations visible.
options: Allow implied trusted-project writes; ask destructive deletes or broad rewrites
Allow all trusted-project writes and deletes
Ask for all trusted-project writes and deletes

questions.label: What should outside-project file writes default to?
questions.help: Recommended: ask by default unless the user explicitly requested the outside-project path in the current task.
options: Ask by default unless explicitly requested in the current task
Allow if explicitly requested, deny otherwise

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether git, terminal, network, credential, clone, branch, and delete operations should each have separate defaults.
